message:
fix(llm): preserve usage availability and sparse stream accounting

Distinguish normalized usage/cost object presence from absent reports and explicitly label Harbor backfill estimates. Sparse cost, token and detail chunks preserve unrelated prior accounting; cumulative snapshots are not summed. A prompt-details object does not prove individual zero cache fields were reported by the provider.

Regressions failed on the published base before the fix. Full Go 1.26.4 race suites pass for llm, corrections and Bifrost, including 128-way isolation and existing cost-event round trips. Phase 268 smoke: 9 OK, 0 SKIP, 0 FAIL. Scoped pinned lint: 0 issues; full Markdown: 594 files, 0 errors. Protocol generators, mirror and whitespace checks pass. Unchanged pinned vendor is not committed. Remaining bounded request diagnostics and full final-tree release gates remain pending; no RC claim.
